title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.34211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies policy learning for cooperative task allocation in open multi-agent systems, where submodular utilities model diminishing marginal returns due to overlapping agent contributions. While standard methods evaluate every candidate action to update the policy, this may incur an excessive computational cost online. Hence, we impose a budget on these evaluations and analytically study the effect of query budget on online learning. Our algorithm samples a prescribed number of agent-action pairs and applies inverse-probability weighting to their marginal gains, yielding an unbiased gradient estimate of the expected stage utility for a Kullback-Leibler (KL) mirror-ascent update. We derive a $1/2$-approximate regret bound that elegantly splits into a tracking error between optimal and learned policies, quantified by their KL divergence, and a query-dependent feedback term. translated_title: 开放多智能体系统中的计算感知次模在线学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究开放多智能体系统中协作任务分配的策略学习问题，其中次模效用函数刻画了智能体贡献重叠所导致的边际收益递减现象。尽管标准方法会评估所有候选动作以更新策略，但这在线上场景中可能带来过高的计算开销。因此，我们对这些评估施加预算约束，并从理论层面分析查询预算对在线学习的影响。所提出的算法按预设数量采样智能体-动作对，并对其边际收益进行逆概率加权，从而获得期望阶段效用的无偏梯度估计，用于Kullback-Leibler（KL）镜像上升更新。我们推导出1/2近似遗憾界，该界优雅地分解为最优策略与学习策略之间以KL散度衡量的跟踪误差，以及一个与查询次数相关的反馈项。在协作信息覆盖任务上的实验表明（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种带查询预算的计算感知次模在线学习算法，通过采样和逆概率加权获得无偏梯度估计，并推导出可分解为KL散度跟踪误差与查询相关反馈项的1/2近似遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compute-aware submodular online learning algorithm with a query budget, which obtains unbiased gradient estimates via sampling and inverse-probability weighting, and derives a 1/2-approximate regret bound that decomposes into a KL-divergence tracking error and a query-dependent feedback term.
